hassan.title: Hassan II Mosque
hassan.desc: Africa’s largest mosque, built partly over the Atlantic with a 210 m minaret.

corniche.title: Corniche & Ain Diab
corniche.desc: Ocean promenade, beach clubs and Atlantic sunsets along the coast.

habous.title: Quartier Habous
habous.desc: 1930s neo-Moorish arcades, craft shops and quiet cafés near the Royal Palace.

medina.title: Old Medina
medina.desc: A compact, working medina of food stalls and everyday Casablanca life.

place_mv.title: Place Mohammed V
place_mv.desc: Civic square framed by Art Deco and neo-Mauresque public buildings.

ricks.title: Rick’s Café
ricks.desc: Homage to the 1942 film, with piano, period décor and a refined menu.

villa.title: Villa des Arts
villa.desc: Contemporary art inside a restored Art Deco villa.

marche.title: Marché Central
marche.desc: Fresh seafood, spices and everyday produce in the city centre.
